solution: Years ago, the Earth's orbit shifted and intersected with a parallel world. A fetus in a pregnant woman's belly accidentally shifted into the belly of her counterpart in the parallel world. She mistakenly thought she had a miscarriage, and her family subsequently broke apart. The other woman mistakenly thought she had twins, and her family was happy ever since. From then on, the two worlds were no longer parallel. Until eight years later, for some reason, the shift was corrected, attempting to force the two worlds back into parallel.
canonical_facts: Earth’s orbit shifts and two parallel worlds intersect
A fetus moves into the womb of the corresponding woman in the other world
The first woman believes she miscarried and her marriage breaks apart
The other woman believes she has twins and raises a happy family
Eight years later the shift is corrected, returning the child to the first woman’s world
The child recognizes her and the father’s names while she cannot recognize this son
